notes: Type popup (from the plug-in's resources): 1 Straight Zoom, 2 Fading Zoom, 3 Centered Zoom, 4 '(-' separator, 5 Rotate, 6 Scratch, 7 Rotate Fading (AE default 6). Measured: the blur spans Amount/200 of the full range. Straight Zoom (Amount 30): average of the layer at scales s = 1 - (Amount/200)*i/n, i = 0..n-1 (one-sided towards Center), nonparametric kernel fit confirmed the uniform range [0.85, 1]. Scratch (Amount 40): average of the rotations in [-a, +a], 2a = Amount/200 turn (+-36 deg), n+1 samples including both ends (nonparametric angular kernel fit: uniform over +-36 deg). Sample count per pixel n = ceil(L / 1.9 px) at Quality 50, L = streak length at that pixel (Amount/200 * r for zooms, 2a*r for rotations) — this reproduces AE's alternating 2-px stepping in the streaks and the ghosting near Center. Bilinear, transparent outside the layer, output truncated (floor) to 8 bits. Type 4 (separator) renders nothing in AE: reproduced exactly. Residuals: Straight Zoom 0.10 % mean, max 21 (sample-placement details); Scratch 0.41 % mean, max 34, mostly within ~150 px of Center where AE shows a finer pixel moire than this model (nearest sampling and fixed counts were worse). Centered Zoom (fitted on the held-out cc_radial_blur_3, Amount 25): uniform over the scales [1 - Amount/400, 1 + Amount/400] (nonparametric kernel fit), n = ceil(L/1.9) samples at t = (i+1)/n, inner end included and outer end excluded (other placements: 9-30 % px > 8). NOT measured (inferred): Fading Zoom / Rotate Fading weights fading linearly to 0 at the far end, Rotate = the Scratch model, Rotate Fading one-sided [0, Amount/200 turn], negative Amounts (mirrored), Quality (sample spacing 1.9*50/Quality px). More than 512 samples are spread evenly.
